sources.title: 2025 Instructions for Form 1040
sources.heading: Line 25b—Form(s) 1099
sources.assessment: Line 25b includes the withholding shown on Forms 1099. A truthful no to the statement question supplies no box 4 withholding to carry from that statement.

sources.title: 2025 Instructions for Form 1099-B
sources.heading: Box 4. Federal Income Tax Withheld
sources.assessment: Box 4 is the reported federal withholding amount. No is statement-local, not a declaration about all withholding or all statements.

sources.title: 2025 Form 1099-B, Copy B instructions for recipient
sources.heading: Box 4.
sources.assessment: The recipient instructions direct inclusion of this amount as tax withheld. An explicit positive amount beside no is contradictory; retaining the explicit amount preserves the existing recorded amount rather than claiming the pair is truthful.

published_questions: Both the yes/no question and amount prompt remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
inference_limit: No is zero withholding to carry from the identified statement as reported. It does not resolve an incorrect information return or other statements.
